description: Exact official MiniMax H3 Ref2VA partition (the original checkpoint layout under Ref2VA/, the folder the creator's two-Spark vLLM-Omni stack loads) for reference-to-video-and-audio generation, including long clips by latent-tail continuation. The text encoder, VAEs, processors and tokenizers are byte-identical to the FL2VA partition; the transformer differs.
